name: Vimes' Report
summary: Vimes' Report carries an update on a delicate situation to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore. Vimes entrusts its delivery to someone better placed to answer her questions.

sections.title: A Delicate Situation
sections.body: Vimes has kept Lady Jaina Proudmoore informed about a delicate situation, though he has not spoken with her for some time. He entrusts his report to you, believing you can answer her questions better than he can.

faq.answer: Vimes' Report is an update on a delicate situation, meant for Lady Jaina Proudmoore.
The report is for Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.

faq.q: Why does Vimes ask me to deliver it?
faq.answer: Vimes believes you can answer Lady Jaina's questions better than he can.
The report concerns a delicate situation, but its details are not stated here.
